author: 5kO0
content:
Spun out from #3 after attempting to extend the format-to-newtype mapping to params and finding 224 compile errors in the codegen-emitted helpers.

The codegen emits two helper functions per XRPC method that assume String params:
  - to_query_params(p: &Params) -> proto_blue_xrpc::QueryParams
      uses `v.clone()` and wraps in `QueryValue::String(...)` — needs `v.to_string()` (Display) instead
  - params_from_ctx(ctx) -> Option<Params>
      uses `ctx.params.get("k").cloned()` (yields Option<String>) — needs FromStr::from_str / Did::new etc.

What's needed in proto-blue-codegen/src/generator.rs:
  1. Update generate_query_call_fn / generate_procedure_call_fn (or wherever to_query_params is emitted) to call .to_string() instead of .clone() for string-typed fields.
  2. Update params_from_ctx emission to call <Newtype>::from_str / <Newtype>::new on get'd values, propagating parse errors as a 400 / param-decode error.
  3. Re-extend param_type_to_rust to map LexString.format → newtypes the same way #3 does for type_to_rust.
  4. Regenerate proto-blue-api/src/generated/ and run cargo fmt.
  5. Verify cargo build --workspace; cargo test --workspace.

Reference: the type_to_rust mapping landed in #3 via a string_format_to_rust(format: Option<&str>) -> &'static str helper at the bottom of generator.rs. Reuse it for params.

This is a smaller, targeted follow-up — the audit's primary value (typed object fields at the public API boundary) already landed in #3.
